description.value: 350°F Korean Fried Chicken is a Korean-style fried chicken franchise on East Broadway in Vancouver, serving an extensive lineup of bone-in chicken in flavors ranging from classic Original to Yangnyeom (sweet gochujang), Soy Garlic, and Cheese Snow. The restaurant offers both dine-in and pickup ordering, with a second location in Port Coquitlam. Portions are hearty and include combo meals with fries, coleslaw, and a drink — a solid calorie stop for a cyclist on a long day.
